prompts.name: Тихий список
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality Russian Android app interface for Eluno, a local Matter smart-device controller. Source grounding is actual workspace code and docs, not an attached screenshot: /Users/andrew/Work/Projects/My/Eluno/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/CONTEXT.md, app/src/main/kotlin/ru/eluno/app/MainActivity.kt, feature/devices/src/main/kotlin/ru/eluno/feature/devices/DevicesFeature.kt, core/testing/src/main/kotlin/ru/eluno/core/testing/FakeMatter.kt. These source contents have been read; relevant facts are transcribed here. Existing UI uses Jetpack Compose Material 3 default light/dark color schemes, system theme and optional Android dynamic colors, no bespoke brand assets. Preserve that restrained Material 3 design family and propose polish using warm white #FFFBFE, ink #211F26, lavender #EADDFF, purple #6750A4, secondary grey #625B71, muted neutral surfaces. Readable Roboto-like typography. Source routes: devices, device detail, demo addition, settings. Devices expose controls ONLY according to actual capabilities: outlet = power only; desk lamp = power, brightness 5–100%, temperature 2700–6500K; LED strip = power, brightness, temperature, color. A device's last confirmed state is distinct from pending and reachability. Unknown or stale must never be displayed as off. This is the existing demo build, so a quiet but legible visible line must say "Деморежим · данные имитируются". No claims about live connectivity. No invented account, cloud, room management, automations, scenes, energy statistics, thermostat, camera or weather. Local-only philosophy. Main use case: quickly check and control individual devices, tap a device for details. Settings can be a gear in the top bar, add is supporting action. Do not fabricate bottom navigation with unsupported routes. Current date anchor 31 October 2026 Europe/Moscow, avoid absolute dates unless needed.
Target dimensions: one portrait 390 x 844 app-content viewport, same aspect ratio if generated at higher resolution. Output ONLY the app UI edge-to-edge, rectangular with no outer page, no phone frame/bezel/body, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, system clock, signal, battery, home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask, mockup shadow, captions or presentation background. One independent concept, no side-by-side screens.
Create clear hierarchy, strong typography, purposeful spacing, body 14–16 logical px, comfortable 48dp touch targets. Prefer spacing, alignment and dividers; avoid borders or shadows except when needed. No cards inside cards. Do not pad the frame with extra features. All visible text must be sharp, correct Russian and have sufficient contrast. Use refined Material-style line icons, not emoji. No stock photos, decorative lifestyle scenes or marketing copy. Show a focused primary screen with the hero device-control use case and at most two supporting content areas.
Direction name: "Тихий список". This is a deliberately elegant, typography-first device overview. Top small wordmark "eluno" with gear icon at right; generous upper spacing, large heading "Устройства", then the demo disclosure in muted purple small text. Below a small section caption "МОИ УСТРОЙСТВА", a unified list of four beautifully aligned device rows with ample vertical breathing space and very subtle hairline separators, no individual floating cards.
Row one: simple lamp icon in lavender circle, "Настольная лампа", two lines "Включено · 65%" and "Тёплый свет · 3 200 K", a clear purple ON switch on the right. This active row may have an extremely subtle lavender wash spanning full content width.
Row two: outlet icon, "Розетка в гостиной", "Выключено", neutral OFF switch right.
Row three: light-strip icon, "Цветная лента", "Включено · 40%", purple ON switch right.
Row four: outlet icon, "Недоступная розетка", orange warning icon plus readable "Нет связи", small "Последнее: выключено". No clickable enabled power switch for this row, use a muted unavailable indicator.
Below the list quiet secondary text "Нажмите на устройство для настройки" and generous empty breathing room. At lower edge a full-width lavender extended add button with plus and label "Добавить устройство". No bottom tabs. The result should feel like an exceptionally polished native Android utility, calm, readable and useful rather than a generic smart-home dashboard.

Direction name: "Пульт устройств". Design a more tactile, compact device-grid overview while preserving the same native Material 3 palette and functional scope. A small "eluno" wordmark upper left and a gear upper right, followed by large "Устройства" and the precise muted demo disclosure "Деморежим · данные имитируются". Main content: a generous two-column grid of four individual device tiles, each truly an independent controllable object, with 20dp outer margin and 12dp gap, 24dp corner radii. No nested cards and no heavy shadows. Each tile has a small refined device icon top-left and an obvious 48dp circular power action top-right. Device names wrap naturally; status and secondary metric sit below.
Top-left tile soft lavender #EADDFF: "Настольная лампа", "Включено", large "65%" and small "Яркость", plus "3 200 K" in small type. Power action solid purple with white power glyph.
Top-right neutral tile: "Розетка в гостиной", "Выключено", outlined neutral power button. Do not add wattage or controls this outlet doesn't support.
Bottom-left soft lavender tile: "Цветная лента", "Включено", "40%" and small "Яркость", a tiny warm orange color dot.
Bottom-right neutral tile: "Недоступная розетка", warning icon and amber "Нет связи", small "Последнее: выключено", disabled power action clearly grey with slash through power glyph.
Grid is dominant and tactile but does not fill every pixel. After it, short muted "Настройки устройства — по нажатию на название" and ample whitespace. A lavender extended floating action button anchored bottom-right reads "+ Добавить". No bottom navigation, no rooms, no multiple home picker, no counts dashboard. Intentionally differentiate hierarchy from a conventional list: glanceable independent device tiles with a very clear separation between tapping a device and pressing its power control. Natural readable Russian.

Direction name: "Управление в фокусе". A focused-device overview with one expanded device and the other devices in compact collapsed rows, a substantially different interaction model from tiles or equal-weight lists. Same calm light Material 3 visual language. Top bar small "eluno", understated plus icon for adding and settings gear, each with spacious touch target. Large heading "Устройства", then "Деморежим · данные имитируются". One expanded lavender-tinted panel, 24dp corners, has a lamp line icon, a two-line header "Настольная лампа" and "Включено", an ON toggle aligned right. Beneath header a small status "Подтверждено только что". Then beautiful large "65%" as the main focal point, small label "Яркость", and a thick horizontal Material brightness slider at 65% with a high-contrast thumb and readable end labels "5%" and "100%". Beneath divider a row "Температура" and "3 200 K", a second elegant warm-ivory-to-cool-lavender slider, range "2 700 K" to "6 500 K". This is a lamp with both dimming and temperature capabilities. At panel foot a very quiet trailing link "Подробнее" with chevron, allowing rename/refresh in details. Do not add color controls to this lamp.
Below, small heading "Другие устройства", then two simple unboxed rows with hairline separators: "Розетка в гостиной", "Выключено", OFF switch; "Цветная лента", a thin progress indicator beside text "Применяем яркость…", secondary text "Подтверждено: 40%", and an ON switch that is visibly disabled during the pending command. The pending state must NOT present the new requested brightness as confirmed. Rows have small matching line icons. Keep enough whitespace between controls so the expanded panel is effortless to read. At bottom a restrained text button with plus "Добавить устройство" and plenty of breathing room. No fake navigation tabs, no scene presets, no extra functions. This is a screen for adjusting the selected lamp immediately while retaining awareness of other devices. Single standalone app screen only.
